headline: Vladimir Putin: We see that the Kyiv regime continues to attack our refining facilities
label: QUOTE
quote: We see that the Kyiv regime continues to attack our refining facilities, despite the US president’s appeal and direct request to refrain from such attacks.
speaker: Vladimir Putin
title: Russian President
caption:
Russian President Vladimir Putin has warned that retaliation against Ukraine is inevitable after ongoing drone strikes on energy infrastructure. Speaking during a Kremlin meeting on Tuesday, Putin accused Kyiv of ignoring direct appeals from Washington to halt attacks on Russian refineries. According to Al Jazeera, these continuing drone operations have significantly impacted Russia domestic fuel processing capabilities.

This escalation comes amid rising tensions along European borders, following recent airspace violations and strategic retaliations reported across the region. VOK brings you the latest developments on this intensifying conflict.
